rationale.conceptual: The method involves applying well-documented algebraic formulas (Grimsditch-Nizzoli model equations) and a standard power-law fit via log transformation. No derivation or novel algorithm is needed; the formulas are provided verbatim. Some care is required in translating the multi-term expressions to code, but this is routine numerical work, not research-level method implementation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has exactly two scored steps: compute 7 SL elastic constants by plugging numbers into formulas, then fit 2 exponents via least squares on 8 data points. Both steps use standard Python libraries (numpy/scipy) with simple CSV and JSON I/O. No environment complexity, no data fetching, and no fragile orchestration.
